name: soft-pink-wings-coquette-cupid
image_vibe: Ethereal high-key Cupid styling with soft petal pink, white satin, glittering gold, and whimsical wings
image_purpose: Create a romantic fantasy fashion portrait for editorial, Valentine, or campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A full-body vertical studio portrait of an original adult woman in modern ethereal Cupid styling against a seamless off-white backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with an ash-blonde messy updo, soft face-framing wispy curls, dewy natural skin, heavy pink blush across cheeks and nose, and doll-like wispy lashes. She wears a white satin mini slip dress with delicate scalloped lace trim, large pale pink feathered wings, a textured gold glitter bow, a red heart-tipped arrow, soft pink patent Mary Jane heels, and white crew socks.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered full-body vertical three-quarter view with the subject crouched or squatting and head tilted, seamless off-white or light-gray background, wings clearly visible behind the subject, and clear contrast among satin, feathers, glitter, and gold accessories.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large soft diffused high-key source with extremely soft minimal shadows, bright pastel-saturated palette, glowy but realistic skin, romantic whimsical dreamy atmosphere, and slight highlight bloom.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-body vertical portrait, photorealistic fashion photography, 85mm lens, f/4, sharp facial focus with controlled soft highlights, realistic satin, lace, feather, glitter, shoe, sock, hair, and skin texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic full-body vertical studio portrait of an original adult woman in modern ethereal Cupid styling. Give her an ash-blonde messy updo with soft face-framing wispy curls, dewy natural skin, heavy pink blush across the cheeks and nose, and wispy lashes. Dress her in a white satin mini slip dress with delicate scalloped lace trim, large pale pink feathered wings, a textured gold glitter bow, a red heart-tipped arrow, soft pink patent Mary Jane heels, and white crew socks. Pose her crouched or squatting in a dynamic three-quarter view with her head tilted, centered against a seamless off-white or light-gray studio backdrop. Use a large soft diffused high-key light source with extremely soft minimal shadows, bright petal-pink, clean white, cream, gold, and soft-red palette, realistic satin, lace, feathers, glitter, hair, shoe, sock, and skin texture, an 85mm lens at f/4, sharp facial focus with slight soft highlight bloom, subtle film grain, romantic whimsical dreamy editorial polish, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed wings, broken arrow, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source soft-pink Cupid fashion portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for white satin slip dress, pink wings, glitter bow, heart-tipped arrow, Mary Jane shoes, socks, crouched pose, and high-key studio palette; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult fantasy-fashion subject, white satin and lace, pink feathered wings, glitter bow, heart arrow, pink shoes, socks, crouched pose, off-white studio, and dreamy mood. Identity and non-essential details may vary.

changes: Clarified the source's youthful wording as an original adult while retaining the whimsical non-explicit fashion concept.
